projects.title: Smart Waste Detection & Sorting System
projects.description: A low-cost, real-time system that classifies waste into plastic, metal, and organic categories using an ESP32-CAM and a TinyML model running directly on the microcontroller, then sorts it automatically with servo motors.

projects.title: Subnet & IP Address Calculator
projects.description: A local Python desktop tool that instantly breaks down any IP address and CIDR into its network address, broadcast address, subnet mask, and usable host range.
